candidateReviews.independentTreatment: Catalog of Fishes recognizes Caranx sexfasciatus as valid.
Catalog of Fishes lists current status as valid Ferdauia ferdau and records older valid combinations.

WoRMS accepts Planiliza melinoptera for Chelon melinopterus, while NCBI Taxonomy displays Chelon melinopterus as current and Planiliza melinopterus among homotypic synonyms. The genus and ending treatment differs.
Catalog of Fishes and WoRMS list Glossogobius guirus as a synonym of Glossogobius giuris.
Catalog of Fishes recognizes Lutjanus russellii as valid.
Catalog of Fishes current status is valid as Osteomugil perusii and records Moolgarda perusii as a historically used valid combination.
Catalog of Fishes recognizes Toxotes jaculatrix as valid.
Catalog of Fishes recognizes Upeneus moluccensis as valid.

Catalog of Fishes, GBIF/CoL and CSIRO CAAB support Yarica hyalosoma as a recognized species name, but Bayawan prints halasoma. This remains a separate spelling hypothesis; GBIF did not return a species-level match.

remainingUnreviewed.treatment: Still pending automated nomenclature proposals; no specialist authority page was checked for each name in this focused pass.

limitations: Taxonomy catalogs address name usage, not the identification of particular Bayawan specimens.
